# Experiment report

**Status: DRAFT — NOT YET APPROVED OR INTEGRATED.** Route version `0.2.0-draft`. For the reference task with its real public labels, see `REFERENCE_TASK_FIDELITY_REPORT.md`.

**Mode: SIMULATION.** Generated by `experiments/run_experiments.py` (seed 20261013, 2000 trials per cell, Python 3.13.16). Do not edit by hand; rerun to regenerate. Fixtures are synthetic labels with the reference task's size and class counts (7/5/6/6/6), not the published reference labels, and synthetic models; no real model was evaluated. Fidelity gap = released − plaintext metric. Simulated noise uses the same calibrated scale as production (for every ε below it equals the textbook 2/ε, checked by `calibrated_scale`).
